notes.append drops a newcomer whole on a cell at the cap whose every segment is protected - a guarantee written for a tool that only ADDS. Paired with replace_own it deletes the segment and then fails to write the replacement, so the ~33-char-longer fold costs Syte (208 chars, 4/4 protected) both the phrase and this tool's stamp. Killed by test_the_fold_is_skipped_when_writing_it_would_cost_the_pool_it_protects. Re-anchored 2026-08-31 (b): the guard now asks the POOL PREDICATE, not the literal phrase (the proxy got Syte wrong). Removing the check is the same defeat.
